name: Ferga
description: The first educational platform in Kurdistan and Iraq — and the largest marketplace for learning your favourite subject.
longDescription: An education marketplace: find the best teacher, course, school or centre. Trilingual (English, Kurdish, Arabic), live on the web, with the mobile apps in preparation.

name: Poshya
description: Trilingual multi-vendor marketplace for Kurdistan and Iraq, with video reels and vector image search.
longDescription: A multi-vendor marketplace covering Kurdistan and Iraq: storefronts, product and video-reel content, vector image search, and multi-language shopping in English, Arabic and Sorani Kurdish. Live on the web and published on Google Play as an Android app.

name: Gulzare Maily
description: Event design and styling for weddings, birthdays and celebrations — گوڵزاری مەیلی.
longDescription: A design practice for private celebrations: weddings, birthdays and gatherings. Styling, decoration and visual identity for events, run as its own studio.

name: Jumla Iraq
description: B2B wholesale marketplace connecting suppliers and buyers across Iraq.
longDescription: A trilingual B2B wholesale platform — جملة العراق — where suppliers list in bulk and buyers source stock. Server-rendered for search visibility, with supplier and buyer accounts, RFQs and sponsored placement.

name: Shaz Print
description: Kurdish-first marketing site for a printing, signage and branding business.
longDescription: A full right-to-left Sorani Kurdish marketing site for a printing house: printing, signage, branding and gift work, with a direct contact and quotation flow.

name: Gihan
description: Multi-tenant retail ERP and POS: sales, stock ledgers, customer debts, cash boxes and profit reporting.
longDescription: A retail ERP and point-of-sale for shops: multi-store operation, stock ledgers, customer debt tracking with debts locked at sale-time price, cash boxes, expenses and profit reporting. Four languages with full RTL, delivered as an installable PWA.

name: Zuba
description: Wholesale and distribution ERP: bulk invoicing, multi-warehouse stock, trader accounts and payments.
longDescription: A distribution and wholesale ERP and the successor to the Luqman Tech system: bulk invoicing, multi-warehouse stock control, trader accounts with running balances, and payment tracking. Four languages with full RTL.

name: Kapitan POS
description: Offline point-of-sale for cafés, fast food and counter businesses — menu ordering with Bluetooth thermal receipt printing.
longDescription: A ready-to-deploy offline POS for menu-based counter businesses: take orders on a tablet or phone and print receipts over Bluetooth, with no internet connection required. Built in Flutter (v1.0.5+2) for cafés, fast food, bakeries and juice shops.
